name: Coagulation and fibrinolysis with factor XII contact activation
rationale: All members concern clot formation, fibrin dissolution or plasminogen/fibrinogen regulation, and unlike the VWF- and F8/F9-variant confusables the theme carries the intrinsic FXIIa/plasma kallikrein arm, including amyloid-triggered FXII activation and hereditary angioedema.

core: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
qualifier: optic nerve and ganglion cell axon formation
name: Eye morphogenesis, retinal neuron differentiation and optic nerve formation
rationale: All members are developmental steps of the eye (optic cup, iris, eyelid, retinal layering, rod/bipolar/amacrine differentiation), and the optic nerve and retinal ganglion axon guidance members separate it from the lens/cornea and phototransduction confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing and calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members cover intramitochondrial protein processing/turnover (including SMDT1 processing) plus regulation of mitochondrial calcium import, which the protein-import and cristae confusables lack.

qualifier: peroxisomal alpha-oxidation of branched fatty acids
name: Short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisomal alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members are short/medium-chain fatty acid and acyl-CoA (malonyl-, succinyl-CoA) metabolism together with phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, the branched-chain peroxisomal arm absent from the mitochondrial beta-oxidation and VLCFA confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and mutants
rationale: All members describe cancer-associated fusions, amplifications, translocations or mutants of FGFR1-3, PDGFRA/B and ALK/LTK kinases, distinguishing them from the EGFR/ERBB2 and KIT/drug-resistance confusables.

name: Oxygen metabolism and ischemia and hydrogen sulfide responses
rationale: The three members share a theme of oxygen supply and gaseous-signal stress (oxygen metabolism, ischemia, H2S), unlike the peroxide, nitrosative and KATP channel confusables.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine synthesis
rationale: Members cover folate/tetrahydrofolate and formate metabolism and transport plus MTR/MTRR-dependent methionine and sulfur amino acid synthesis, separating it from the SAM/methionine-salvage confusables (which lack folate) and the folate-response confusable (which lacks methionine synthesis).

name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: All members concern the oocyte-to-embryo handover (zygotic genome activation, pronuclear epigenetic programming, cleavage, maternal stores), and the M-/Z-decay and deadenylation members distinguish it from the germline/piRNA confusables.

name: Pre-rRNA processing and snoRNA-guided rRNA methylation
rationale: Members are nucleolar pre-rRNA cleavages and Pol I rRNA output plus box C/D snoRNP assembly and rRNA 2'-O-/base methylation, which the RNA-decay and ribosome-assembly confusables lack.

name: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation
rationale: Every member is chromosome condensation in prophase/prometaphase of mitosis or meiosis, distinct from the cohesion, CENP-A and meiotic segregation confusables.

qualifier: p53/DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition, checkpoint and p53/DREAM-repressed cycle genes
rationale: Members cover cyclin B:Cdk1/PLK/MASTL G2/M events and the G2/M checkpoint plus p53- and DREAM/p107-p130-mediated transcriptional repression of cell cycle genes, distinguishing it from APC/C, G1/S and GTSE1 confusables.

qualifier: reactive oxygen species and protein repair
name: Reactive oxygen and aldehyde detoxification with protein repair
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification and protein repair, with the ROS and redox members separating it from the molybdenum-cofactor, glutathione and chaperone confusables.

name: Proximal TCR signaling and its co-inhibition by CTLA4/BTLA
rationale: Members are CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment and their negative regulation by CTLA4 and BTLA, distinct from the CD28 costimulation, downstream TCR and BCR confusables.

name: snRNP biogenesis, splicing and histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members cover snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport and spliceosome function together with SLBP-dependent/independent histone mRNA 3'-end processing, unlike the polyadenylation and mRNA export confusables.

name: Cytoplasmic translation: 43S formation, subunit joining and elongation
rationale: All four members are core ribosomal steps from free 40S pool and 43S complex formation through 60S joining to peptide elongation, separate from scanning/eIF3, termination/NMD and rRNA processing confusables.

name: Cytochrome P450 vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members center on CYP-mediated vitamin D activation/inactivation and VDR signaling plus CYP26B1/C1 retinoic acid hydroxylase disorders, which the phosphate/FGF23 and vitamin K confusables lack.

name: APC/C substrate degradation and Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch in mitotic exit
rationale: All members concern APC/C activity, phosphorylation, inhibition and Cdc20/Cdh1-dependent degradation during mitotic exit, whereas confusables are spindle/PLK1 or Emi1-centred metaphase-anaphase sets.

qualifier: AP-1 induction and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and ARE-mediated mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine growth-factor/TNF/KRAS-induced AP-1 immediate-early programs with TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1 and HuR control of AU-rich mRNA stability, the AP-1 side distinguishing it from stress-granule/translation confusables and the ARE side from FOSL-target confusables.

qualifier: kainate receptors and G beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
name: Kainate/AMPA receptor transmission and G beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation and kainate responses plus Gbeta/gamma-mediated GIRK activation and calcium-channel inhibition at presynaptic terminals, separating it from the AMPA-trafficking, nicotinic and vesicle-release confusables.

qualifier: C-strand replication, capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomere replication, capping and suppression of telomeric recombination
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis, capping/NHEJ protection, D-loop and t-circle control, and ATRX/DAXX-dependent inhibition of telomeric recombination, while lacking the telomerase extension and Cajal body members of the confusables.

name: Ectodermal placode formation and epithelial lumen cavitation
rationale: The three members are early ectoderm-derived epithelial morphogenesis events (ectodermal differentiation, hair placode, lumen cavitation), unlike the keratinocyte, hair cycle and salivary branching confusables.

name: Microtubule organelle transport and endosome/lysosome size regulation
rationale: Members concern plus-end microtubule transport and distribution of mitochondria, synaptic vesicles and organelles plus endosome/lysosome size control, separating it from the neuronal cargo, tubulin-modification and lysosome-fusion confusables.

core: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
qualifier: N-glycan processing and lysosomal glycan catabolism
name: Hexosamine/sialic acid metabolism, N-glycan processing and lysosomal glycan degradation
rationale: Members span UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid synthesis, N-glycan processing and lysosomal degradation of gangliosides and oligosaccharides, combining the hexosamine/N-glycosylation arm absent from the GAG/MPS confusable with the lysosomal arm absent from the glycan-biosynthesis confusables.

core: Golgi positioning and membrane carrier formation
name: Golgi positioning, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi localization and membrane protein targeting, Golgi vesicle budding, constitutive secretion and endosome tubulation, distinct from the Golgi ribbon reassembly and Rab/ARF regulation confusables.

name: CDC42-IQGAP control of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, actin polymerization and integrin/focal adhesion dynamics, with the CDC42 cycle and IQGAP members distinguishing it from the WASP/WAVE, invadopodia and macropinocytosis confusables.
